evals.prompt: Package the agentic-forge diagnostics for this repo into a zip I can share.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the bundler over the last 7 days and writes a single zip to ~/Downloads named agentic-forge-diagnostics-<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.zip, then reports the path plus the event/session counts and the covered window.
assertions: Exactly one .zip is written under the user's ~/Downloads directory (not the repo, not /tmp)
The filename matches agentic-forge-diagnostics-<timestamp>.zip with a UTC timestamp
The bundle contains README.md, log-summary.txt, environment.txt, and repo-logs/{audit,diagnostics}.jsonl at a single top-level folder
The default window is the last 7 days and the README/log-summary states the covered window
The final message reports the absolute output path and the audit/diagnostics counts

evals.prompt: Collect the last 30 days of plugin diagnostics into a bundle in Downloads.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs with a 30-day window, writes the consistently-named zip to ~/Downloads, and the report states a 30-day window; no secrets are included.
assertions: The window is 30 days (the user-specified value overrides the 7-day default) and is reflected in the report
Records outside the window are excluded while records lacking a timestamp are retained
No secret or credential appears anywhere in the bundle (logs and config slices are redacted)
The settings slice contains only enablement + hooks keys, never tokens

component.purpose: A manual utility skill that packages a repo's plugin diagnostics (last N days, default 7) into one redacted, consistently-named zip in ~/Downloads for sharing with a maintainer; a thin workflow over the tested agentic_forge.diag_bundle lib.
